notes: PAP reference G55/0084. Whole four-room ground-floor duplex in Tours. The full advert describes an entrance with storage, principal bedroom and shower room on the ground floor, fitted open kitchen, living and dining area opening through three bay windows to a 30 m2 terrace and 167 m2 planted garden, plus two bedrooms, bathroom and separate WC upstairs. It states electric heating, air conditioning and immediate access to shops, restaurants, buses and tram. PAP exposed 11 property photos and a publication date of 29 September 2026.

PAP reference G31/2971. Whole three-room apartment on the second floor overlooking place de la Resistance in central Tours. The complete concise advert describes two bedrooms, a large living and dining room, a small balcony, a right to park within the surrounding blocks and an 8 m2 attic. The current EUR 360,000 price reflects the disclosed EUR 10,000 reduction. PAP exposed 11 property photos and a publication date of 28 September 2026. No reliable DPE grade, charges or property tax was exposed.

PAP reference G54/2945. Whole six-room duplex on avenue de Grammont in central Tours. The full advert describes a kitchen, two bedrooms including one with private bathroom, separate WC, large living and dining area opening to a roughly 30 m2 terrace on the first level, plus three further bedrooms and three bathrooms upstairs. The apartment needs refreshing and a new heating system after removal of the oil boiler. Potential future subdivision is described only as an option subject to feasibility and approvals; the offer is for the complete duplex. PAP exposed 8 property photos and a publication date of 28 September 2026.

PAP reference F49/1630. Whole two-room loft apartment on the third and top floor without lift in rue des Augustins, Reims. The full advert describes an open kitchen, partially open bedroom, bright courtyard exposure, exposed beams and a cellar; the apartment has 32 m2 Carrez and 50 m2 floor area, advertised as 40 m2. It states electric heating, annual condominium charges of EUR 556, property tax of EUR 525 and DPE G. Prior rental income is historical and no current tenant is stated. PAP exposed 12 property photos plus a virtual tour and a publication date of 26 September 2026.

PAP reference G53/2946. Whole T1/F1 bis on the fourth floor with lift in a secured residence in Tours' Prebendes-Rabelais district. The full advert describes an entrance with wardrobe, large bright main room, independent fitted kitchen and shower room with WC, plus double glazing, shutters, collective gas heating, bicycle room and shared secured parking. It was previously rented furnished and no current tenant is stated. Annual charges are EUR 950 and property tax EUR 504. PAP exposed 4 property photos and a publication date of 22 September 2026.

PAP reference G54/1319. Whole T1 in a maintained 1991 residence near boulevard Lundy in Reims. The full advert describes a living room, independent kitchen, shower room with WC and entrance storage, with recently renewed decoration and individual electric heating. It states 30.83 m2 Carrez, DPE C dated 1 June 2026, annual condominium charges of EUR 600 and property tax of EUR 895. PAP exposed 9 property photos and a publication date of 24 September 2026.
